retrievalProfile.description: A gritty urban portrait featuring a central figure against a dark, towering apartment block with high-contrast lighting and street-level elements like traffic lights and signs.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in a white graphic t-shirt stands before a dark, monolithic brick apartment building at night. The scene is framed by street infrastructure, including a traffic light and a green street sign, with a heavy, textured sky overhead.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the foreground against a massive architectural backdrop
Street sign and traffic light provide horizontal and vertical framing elements
High contrast between the bright white shirt and the dark, shadowy environment
Textured, overcast sky blends into the top of the building
coreInvariants: Towering brick apartment building with repetitive window patterns
Urban street furniture (traffic light, street sign) as framing devices

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot of a male figure, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white t-shirt of the central figure acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the central figure, the eye moves up to the street sign, then follows the building's height into the dark sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and dark, primarily in the upper corners and the shadows of the building.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal and deep brown (building and sky)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Green and amber (street sign and traffic light)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast on the central subject.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant primary colors except for functional street elements

letterConstructionRules: Condensed proportions for street sign text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans for branding paired with condensed sans for environmental text.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory badge in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and urban feel for display text.
Classic urban sans-serif with strong presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, gritty urban scene at night featuring a massive brick apartment building. Include a traffic light and a green street sign in the mid-ground. Place a male figure in a white t-shirt in the center foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white geometric sans-serif text in the top left corner. Add condensed white sans-serif text onto the green street sign, matching its perspective.

verificationChecks: Is the building dark and monolithic?
Is the white t-shirt the brightest point in the image?
Is the text clean and legible against the dark background?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between subject and background
Ensure the sky texture is visible but not distracting
Verify the street sign perspective is correct
Confirm the typography is bold and legible
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Monolithic Architecture + High Contrast Lighting + Street Infrastructure Framing
